CF ANALYSIS

Results of a preliminary screening of the leading European brands for CF have been reported recently (1) (2). In continuation of this study, most of the competitive brands listed in the CI-Report (4/5 1980) have now been analysed for CF.
Country, number of brands analysed and number of brands containing CF are listed in Table 1. In Table 2, information concerning brand name, CF concentration (ppm) and manufacturer are given. With regard to the importance of CF as flavourant, the study will be repeated in Autumn 1981.

CONTAMINATED MLK-UK

Following a request made by QC-PME (3), the investigation of two contaminated MLK-UK samples by  \( (GC)^{2}/MS \)  has been started.

SERVICE FOR OTHER GROUPS

Phosphate (51 samples), sulfate (51) and alcohols (43) were determined for Biotechnology and Project NINO, amino acids (16) for Project SPOTLESS.
